# ghost/markor

Markor: create and read Markdown notes, list the notebook, add a todo.txt task, append to QuickNote. Plain files on the device, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/markor
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/markor create_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param content=<content>
ghost skill run ghost/markor read_note --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/markor list_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/markor add_todo --device <serial> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/markor append_quicknote --device <serial> --param text=<text>
```

## Actions

- `create_note`: Make a note called Shopping with milk and eggs
- `read_note`: Read my Shopping note in Markor
- `list_notes`: What notes do I have in Markor?
- `add_todo`: Add 'call mom' to my to-do list in Markor
- `append_quicknote`: Quick note: parking spot is B12
